conditionalHeightProjection.assumption: One native screenshot pixel maps through the locomotion cell scale; unverified as a physics conversion.

browserShot.method: advanceShotAirborne, one fixed tick at a time, no impacts

limitations: The 38/52 ratio describes the captured runtime-body and action reference scale; other rendering fallbacks may differ.
Locomotion cells contain transparency; their render scale does not prove a native-to-web physical unit mapping.
Native height-to-pixel observations cover only two heights from one synthetic scene.
Shot simulation excludes player contact, crossbar collision, and rebounds; it is not proof of every in-game trajectory.
Native field X/Y ratios are browser design choices; crossbar and net geometry are not established by this calculation.
